identity.description:
Reviewer briefing and reading plans (D7)

## Summary

This PR gives the reviewers the briefing and the reading procedure of D7. It closes #20 and #25. D6 already put the PR title, labels and body in the description block.

- The reviewer user message holds a `changed_files` block before the diff. A deleted file has its own line, because the head checkout has no file to read.
- Gather records the changed files that the change deletes.
- diff-bugs, history, tests and security each have a reading plan in numbered steps. Each plan starts with the changed files in full, then reads the callers and callees, then the tests that cover the changed behaviour. The history plan matches the blame lines of prior fixes against the diff. The security plan follows each outside input to its uses and reads the checks that guard each changed handler.
- conventions, docs-and-comments and description-drift get no read-in-full step. They work from the diff and read files only when they need context.
- The design (section 3.4) and TICKETS.md record the change.

## Eval

One repeat on the pinned cases (`e6ddf81`) against the 0.5.0 baseline. The gate passed.

| Metric | Baseline 0.5.0 | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Recall | 0.396 | 0.431 |
| Precision | 0.722 | 0.818 |
| Adjudicated precision | n/a | 0.939 |
| Raw recall | n/a | 0.616 |
| Cost per PR | $4.65 | $6.03 |

| Case | Raw recall | Recall | Precision | Posted | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| martian-calcom-8330 | 0.714 | 0.571 | 0.667 | 6 | $11.23 |
| martian-discourse-graphite-1 | 1.000 | 0.625 | 0.833 | 6 | $14.29 |
| martian-sentry-93824 | 0.889 | 0.778 | 1.000 | 7 | $7.90 |
| martian-sentry-greptile-1 | 0.889 | 0.667 | 0.750 | 8 | $11.65 |
| reviewbench-axios-10836 | 1.000 | 0.500 | 1.000 | 1 | $1.40 |
| reviewbench-claire-de-binare-1550 | 0.000 | 0.000 | - | 0 | $3.44 |
| reviewbench-disaster-ninja-fe-1166 | 1.000 | 0.667 | 0.667 | 3 | $3.70 |
| reviewbench-ensnode-1938 | 0.000 | 0.000 | - | 0 | $0.74 |
| reviewbench-flatten-js-244 | 0.333 | 0.167 | 1.000 | 1 | $2.99 |
| reviewbench-statswales-frontend-626 | 0.333 | 0.333 | 1.000 | 1 | $2.91 |

Cost per PR rose by 30%. One repeat gives no spread, so the gains in recall and precision can be noise. The baseline has no raw recall to compare with.

This eval ran before the last commit. In that run, every reviewer got the read-in-full instruction. conventions, docs-and-comments and description-drift cost $7.37 over ten cases against $3.28 before D7. A later commit removes the instruction from those three. Its eval at one repeat on the same pin:

| Metric | Baseline 0.5.0 | All seven read in full | Four read in full |
|---|---|---|---|
| Recall | 0.396 | 0.431 | 0.438 |
| Raw recall | n/a | 0.616 | 0.568 |
| Precision | 0.722 | 0.818 | 0.714 |
| Adjudicated precision | n/a | 0.939 | 0.786 |
| Cost per PR | $4.65 | $6.03 | $5.00 |
| Cost of the three reviewers | n/a | $7.37 | $3.32 |

The gate passed. The precision drop comes mostly from sentry-greptile. There, four posted findings state one defect on the same line, and the merge did not join them. Six extras judge queries also gave no answer, so adjudicated precision is a floor. TICKETS.md lists the merge miss as a follow-up. The cost of the four deep reviewers also fell between the two runs, from $13.20 to $10.43, with the same prompts for three of them, so one repeat carries a lot of noise.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass.
- [x] The eval runs at one repeat on the pinned cases and the gate passes.

triage.reason: Changes the reviewer user-message construction, the GatherResult interface and the reviewer prompts, which changes what the LLM reviewers receive and do.
hotspots: src/find/index.ts: describeFiles and buildReviewerMessage (the new files block, the untrusted wrapping, the deleted-file lookup)
src/gather/index.ts: deletedFiles computed from entries filtered by kept and status D
prompts/reviewer-user.md: the {{files}} placeholder in both templates and the new frontmatter fields
prompts/reviewers/*.md: reading plans that make reviewers read whole files, which raises cost

file_notes.note: New ReviewerTexts fields and describeFiles. A changed_files block is added to the message before the diff.
New optional deletedFiles field on GatherResult, set by gather. Check that rename or copy statuses are handled.
New {{files}} placeholder and line templates. Both the history and the default templates must stay in sync with the code's render keys.
Tests the changed_files block order and the deleted-file line.
New git-repo test for deletedFiles. It uses a temp repo.
Tests the reading plan structure and that only four reviewers say read in full.
Design doc update that matches the change.

triage.summary: The change adds a changed_files block to the reviewer user message. The block lists each changed file, and a deleted file has its own line. Gather now reports deletedFiles. The diff-bugs, history, tests and security prompts get numbered reading plans that tell the reviewer to read each changed file in full. Tests, TICKETS.md and the design doc are updated to match.

quotes: if (gathered.changedFiles.length === 0) return texts.emptyListText;
files: wrapUntrusted("changed_files", describeFiles(texts, gathered)).block,

changedFiles: [
        { path: "src/stats.ts", hunks: 1 },
        { path: "src/old.ts", hunks: 1 },
      ],
verifier.rationale: The PR adds the empty-list branch in describeFiles. No test passes an empty changedFiles list: the find test for the changed_files block uses two files, and the empty_list_text tests in prompt-sources only cover the brief's hotspots. The branch is trivial, and a change with no changed files may never reach the reviewers, so the gap matters little.
